mechanism.description: Each stage is dispatched only when (a) its static dependencies are PASS, (b) its declarative extra_gate in changes.json evaluates true against verifiable evidence, and (c) a traceable authorization for that specific stage exists with actor, scope and date. A technical PASS never implies execution permission.
